title: Space Config MCP Values
description: Values for the Space Config MCP Helm chart. A Python FastMCP server on the base chart. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

mcpConfig.description: Non-secret configuration for the space-config-mcp server, mapped to environment variables. Secrets (ZITADEL_JWT_SIGNING_KEY, ENCRYPTION_KEY) go in envVars/secretKeyRef. Zitadel uses a public PKCE client (no client secret).

enabled.description: If disabled, none of the fields below are mapped to environment variables.

publicBaseUrl.description: Public URL of this MCP service (the Gateway/Kong host clients hit). Used for the OAuth redirect base and must match routes.hostname, e.g. https://space-config-mcp.mcp.qa.unique.app.

zitadel.description: Zitadel OIDC issuer (non-secret). Deliver ZITADEL_JWT_SIGNING_KEY via envVars/secretKeyRef.

baseUrl.description: Zitadel issuer base URL, e.g. https://id.qa.unique.app.

clientId.description: Public PKCE client ID for this MCP's Zitadel application.
